caption:
Always waiting for real life to finally begin? It already has. (1 Timothy 6:12, 15–16 devotional)

We keep sending “real life” into the future. But eternal life isn't something you achieve later — it's held today, guaranteed by the King who alone has immortality. Its certainty rests on His deathlessness, not your grip.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — what would change if eternal life were today's reality?
